## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

### Other ways to run it

1. Run it as published (BF16, needs ~19.22 GB, from [github.com/facebookresearch](https://github.com/facebookresearch/omnilingual-asr))
   
   ```sh
   uv run --python 3.12 --with omnilingual-asr python -c "from omnilingual_asr.models.inference.pipeline import ASRInferencePipeline as P; print(P(model_card='omniASR_LLM_7B_v2').transcribe(['audio.wav'], batch_size=1))"
   ```

Official weights and documentation: [github.com/facebookresearch](https://github.com/facebookresearch/omnilingual-asr)
